new_jobs.title: CEO Office 專案營運｜Project Operations &BD｜硬科技新創
new_jobs.company: RobiChip Technology Co. Ltd. 羅比芯科技股份有限公司
new_jobs.jd: 職務說明 羅比芯科技（RobiChip）是一家約 10幾人左右的硬科技新創公司，專注於智慧機器人核心驅動技術，聚焦 Robot SoC、Intelligent Power Module（IPM）、GaN 功率元件整合、馬達控制、先進封裝與人形機器人關節模組開發。 我們正在尋找一位能同時協助「對外專案洽接」與「對內營運推進」的夥伴。這個角色將直接向 CEO 匯報，並與 CEO、技術團隊、合作夥伴、客戶、學研單位及外部資源密切合作，協助把外部機會轉化為內部可執行、可追蹤、可推進的專案任務。 這不是傳統單純業務，也不是只做會議紀錄的 PM。你需要能理解硬科技新創的節奏，在資源有限、事情快速變動的環境中，主動整理資訊、拆解問題、追蹤進度、協調溝通、製作文件，並在必要時依公司優先順序補位，協助把重要事項推進完成。 如果你希望近距離參與新創公司經營、商務開發、技術專案推進與公司營運，並對半導體、機器人、電子硬體或硬科技產業有興趣，這會是一個能快速累積實戰經驗的位置。 你會參與的工作 1.協助 CEO 與團隊進行對外合作洽談，包含企業客戶、產業夥伴、政府 / 法人單位、學研單位與展會資源。 2.整理客戶與合作夥伴需求，協助轉化為內部可討論、可執行、可追蹤的專案任務。 3.負責專案會議安排、會議紀錄、待辦事項追蹤、時程管理與跨部門協調。 4.協助準備商務簡報、合作提案、產品介紹、技術摘要、報價資料與專案進度文件。 5.協助追蹤展會、競賽、補助、育成、政府計畫、產學合作與商務開發機會。 6.協助管理公司內部營運事項，例如招募流程、活動安排、供應商聯繫、文件歸檔與日常行政協調。 7.與工程團隊合作，理解產品開發狀態，協助對外溝通合理的時程、需求與交付內容。 8.協助建立公司基本營運流程，讓專案、文件、聯繫窗口與決策紀錄更有系統。 9.在新創資源有限的情況下，依公司階段需求主動補位，協助把重要事項推進完成。 我們期待你具備 1.具備專案管理、業務開發、營運管理、科技業 PM、產品企劃或相關工作經驗。 2.能直接與 CEO 協作，具備主動回報、資訊整理、進度追蹤與任務閉環能力。 3.能將模糊問題整理成清楚的待辦事項、時程、負責人與下一步行動。 4.具備良好的文字整理與簡報能力，能撰寫會議紀錄、合作摘要、提案文件與專案追蹤表。 5.對半導體、機器人、電子硬體、AIoT、無人機、自動化或硬科技產業有興趣。 6.具備高度責任感、保密意識與職業倫理，能處理商務合作、專案進度與公司營運相關敏感資訊。 7.能接受早期新創環境：節奏快、分工彈性、資源有限，但能直接參與重要任務與公司成長。 8.熟悉 Google Workspace、Excel / Google Sheets、PowerPoint / Canva、Notion 或其他專案管理工具。 9.具備基本英文讀寫能力，能閱讀商務信件、合作文件、技術摘要或展會資料。 加分條件 1.具科技業、半導體、電子硬體、機器人、AIoT、無人機或自動化產業經驗。 2.曾參與 B2B 業務開發、技術合作、政府計畫、展會、補助案或產學合作。 3.具備簡報設計、行銷內容、LinkedIn / 104 / 官網更新、活動企劃或招募協助經驗。 4.有新創公司、育成中心、研究單位或跨部門專案經驗。 5.具備基礎工程背景，或能理解電路、晶片、韌體、馬達控制、機器人系統等技術語言。 6.能進行英文會議溝通或英文簡報製作尤佳。 適合這份工作的人 1.這份工作適合喜歡把混亂整理成流程、把機會推進成專案、把想法落成文件與行動的人。你不需要是工程師，但需要願意理解技術；你不需要一開始什麼都會，但需要主動學習、主動追蹤、主動補位。 2.在羅比芯，這個角色會直接與 CEO 協作，也會是工程團隊、外部合作夥伴與公司營運之間的重要橋樑。這裡適合希望快速累積商務開發、專案管理、硬科技產品化與新創營運實戰經驗的人才。 3.如果你偏好非常明確的單一職務範圍、完整成熟的大公司流程，或不喜歡在變動中主動解決問題，這個角色可能不一定適合。如果你希望在早期新創中靠近決策現場、承擔責任、快速成長，歡迎加入我們。 我們提供 1.直接參與 RobiChip 早期商務開發、專案推進與公司營運的機會。 2.與 CEO、工程團隊、合作夥伴與產業資源直接協作的工作環境。 3.深入了解半導體、功率電子、機器人與硬科技產品化流程的實戰機會。 4.小團隊、低層級、快速決策的工作模式，能直接看見自己的貢獻。 5.彈性上下班與開放式工作環境，工作地點位於臺灣科技大學國際大樓育成中心。 6. 依公司制度提供績效獎金、專案獎勵與長期激勵機制。 工作地點 台北市大安區基隆路四段 43 號 國立臺灣科技大學國際大樓育成中心 關於羅比芯 www.robichip.com 羅比芯科技（RobiChip Technology Co., Ltd.）是一家專注於智慧機器人核心驅動技術的新創公司，聚焦 Robot SoC、IPM、GaN 功率元件整合、馬達控制、先進封裝與人形機器人關節模組開發，應用於人形機器人、無人機與智慧自動化設備。 我們正在打造從晶片設計、功率驅動、韌體控制、PCBA 驗證到機電整合的完整技術平台，讓晶片不只停留在設計與測試，而是真正驅動機器人的下一個動作。

Sanofi Global Hubs with successful transfer of selected activities and integration with advanced Digital technology * Ensure teaming excellence by promoting innovative ways of working through the new_jobs.title: Sr. Strategy & Operations Manager - Earner Growth
new_jobs.jd: **About The Role** As a **Sr. Strategy & Operations Manager for Earner Growth** , you will architect the growth engine powering Uber Eats Taiwan. In this high-impact role, you'll spearhead our supply acquisition strategy—diversifying growth channels, streamlining the onboarding funnel, and shaping a best-in-class early lifecycle experience to maximize earner retention. This position offers a rare blend of strategic ownership and zero-to-one innovation, giving you the freedom to build creative, out-of-the-box initiatives from concept to scale. Collaborating closely with APAC Central Ops and key cross-functional leaders, you will amplify your business impact to the next level. platform, this role is for you. **What You’ll Do** * Architect end-to-end earner acquisition strategy spanning signup, conversion, and Early Life Cycle (ELC) retention. * Pioneer 0-to-1 growth channels and out-of-the-box initiatives across referral programs, strategic partnerships, and online/offline campaigns. * Monitor competitor landscape and market trends to proactively capture market share. * Optimize incentive strategy to drive growth while maximizing spend efficiency, ROI, and experiment rigor. * Analyze and streamline the onboarding funnel step-by-step to eliminate friction and deliver an exceptional first-mile earner experience. * Boost ELC retention by partnering with Product and Marketing on targeted communications and features. * Collaborate with APAC Central Ops and regional markets to exchange insights and scale global best practices locally. * Align with cross-functional partners (Legal, Policy, PR, Safety, Marketing, External Partners) to execute complex, end-to-end ownership—from high-level strategy down to meticulous executional details. * Exceptional executive influence & storytelling, capable of crafting persuasive narratives for senior leadership and external stakeholders. * Relentless growth mindset & "go-getter" attitude, with the curiosity to challenge status quo and unlock disruptive growth levers. **About Uber** With Uber Eats, we're building Uber's fastest-growing business across all six continents. Today, Uber Eats is available across many parts of APAC, including Taiwan, Japan, Sri Lanka, Australia, and New Zealand. Working on the Delivery Partner Growth team, your work will impact a vast and diverse ecosystem—from supporting tens of thousands of earners in Taiwan to ensuring exceptional service quality for our end consumers. You will collaborate with a group of talented people in a transparent and non-hierarchical team culture where your thoughts are always valued and heard. Our teams work with a diverse global customer base across industries, from banking and payments to retail and restaurants. The role will develop practical recommendations, contribute to team discussions on implications of analyses, and work alongside the client’s staff on each project, assisting with implementation tasks. Support the development of a differentiated merchant network across Dining, Lifestyle, Travel, Entertainment and Cardholder Benefits programs. Cover merchant sourcing, onboarding, offer management and ongoing program coordination. Key Responsibilities Client Impact * Provide input on multiple small and large high-value projects across a range of industries and problem statements * Contribute proven, accredited change skills, domain experience, and delivery methodology to help clients drive measurable value * Collaborate with Mastercard team to understand clients’ needs, challenges, agenda, and risks * Develop working relationship with client analysts/managers, and act as trusted and reliable partner * Identify resources and assign responsibilities, track, and forecast effort and report on expense vs. earned value Team Collaboration & Culture * Collaborate with senior project delivery consultants to implement strategically important assets and services * Independently coordinate a complex range of activities and effectively identify and proactively solution risks and impacts on timelines * Lead internal and client meetings with strong communication skills * Contribute to the firm's intellectual capital and be a strong brand ambassador for Mastercard and Data & Services * Receive mentorship from consulting leaders for professional growth and development Vendor & Merchant Support * Manage merchant sourcing activities, including onboarding, documentation and contracting process * Maintain merchant databases, offer inventory and partnership records * Coordinate merchant communications, inquiries and issue resolution across internal teams and third-party vendors Offer Management & Marketing Coordination * Manage offer setup, including validity, redemption periods, campaign schedules, T&C, operational requirements and approvals * Coordinate campaign launch activities, market assets and approvals * Ensure merchant information remains updated across communication channels Program Management & Operational Support * Monitor the program against agreed timelines with trackers and status reports * Prepare recurring performance reports to monitor redemption, utilization and merchant new_jobs.title: Cloud Solution Architect - Centre of Excellence, Field Application Engineering
new_jobs.jd: **ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.** At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career. **THE ROLE** The Centre of Excellence in the Field Application Engineering group is looking for a **Solution Architect** to define and drive architecture for scalable data platforms and cloud-native services exploiting the AMD technologies. This role requires strong expertise in **database technologies, distributed data management, cloud infrastructure, and CPU/system architecture** , with a focus on delivering solutions optimized for **performance, scalability, resiliency, security, and cost efficiency** . The ideal candidate brings architectural leadership and hands-on technical depth across modern data platforms, cloud services, and compute-efficient system design. You will work across software, infrastructure, DevOps, and data teams to translate business and technical requirements into production-ready solutions aligned with AMD engineering standards. **THE PERSON** You are a strong systems thinker with deep technical knowledge in **CPU architecture, cloud platforms with databases and application platforms** . You are comfortable driving architectural trade-offs across storage, networking, compute, and software layers, and you have practical experience optimizing systems using knowledge of modern CPU and memory architecture. You communicate clearly, influence effectively across teams, and bring disciplined engineering judgment to complex platform decisions. **Key Responsibilities** * Define end-to-end architecture for data-intensive and compute-intensive platforms spanning services, databases, storage, cloud infrastructure, security, observability, and operations. * Optimize database platforms across relational, NoSQL, cache, analytical, time-series, and vector databases for transactional, analytical, and AI-driven workloads. * Drive data management architecture including ingestion, transformation, storage, metadata, lineage, governance, retention, archival, backup, and disaster recovery. * Define schema design, indexing, partitioning, sharding, replication, caching, and access patterns to meet performance, availability, and scale requirements. * Evaluate and select data and storage technologies based on workload profile, concurrency, latency, consistency, growth, recoverability, and operational complexity. * Design cloud-native, hybrid, and multi-cloud architectures using AWS, Azure, and/or GCP, including compute, storage, networking, IAM, Kubernetes, containers, and infrastructure-as-code. * Architect platforms for high-throughput and high-performance workloads running on modern server infrastructure, including systems optimized for AMD EPYC™ processor-based environments. * Apply knowledge of CPU and system architecture—including cache hierarchy, NUMA, memory bandwidth, multithreading, SIMD/vectorization, and processor topology—to workload placement, tuning, and capacity planning. * Lead performance analysis and optimization across application, database, and infrastructure layers using tools such as AMD uProf, perf, and cloud monitoring platforms. * Define non-functional requirements and architecture guardrails for scalability, reliability, recoverability, maintainability, security, and operational readiness. * Lead architecture reviews, design discussions, and technical trade-off analysis; document decisions and guide engineering teams through execution. * Evaluate new technologies across databases, cloud platforms, distributed systems, and HPC infrastructure to improve platform capability and efficiency. * Good level of English, both written and spoken * Ability to travel, circa 20% including international travel within Asia, Europe and North America **Required Experience** * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or related field. * 8+ years of experience in solution architecture, software architecture, platform engineering, or senior engineering roles with ownership of production systems. * Strong experience designing database and data platform architecture in enterprise-scale or distributed environments. * Deep knowledge of database technologies including PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, MongoDB, Cassandra, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, data warehouse/lakehouse platforms, and related storage architectures. * Expertise in data modeling, query optimization, indexing, partitioning, replication, high availability, backup/recovery, and database performance troubleshooting. * Strong experience with cloud architecture on AWS, Azure, and/or GCP, including managed data services, networking, security, Kubernetes, containers, and infrastructure automation. * Experience designing hybrid or multi-cloud data platforms with attention to resiliency, governance, and data movement across environments. * Strong understanding of distributed systems, concurrency, consistency, asynchronous processing, and service-oriented or event-driven architectures. * Practical understanding of server CPU architecture and system performance, including x86-64 platforms, memory hierarchy, cache behavior, thread scaling, and bottleneck analysis. * Experience using profiling, benchmarking, and observability tools to improve system and database performance in production environments. * Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively across engineering, infrastructure, product, and leadership teams. **Preferred Experience** * Experience with AMD EPYC™ processors, CPU-aware workload optimization, or tuning for memory-intensive and compute-intensive server workloads. * Experience with distributed compute systems, low-latency platforms, or large-scale data processing environments. * Familiarity with cloud cost optimization, workload rightsizing, and performance-per-dollar analysis. * Experience with streaming and large-scale data processing technologies such as Kafka, Spark, Flink, Delta Lake, Iceberg, or similar. * Experience with vector databases, retrieval systems, and data platforms supporting AI/ML workloads. * Knowledge of data governance, privacy, compliance, and enterprise data security practices. * Familiarity with C++, Rust, or other systems languages for performance-sensitive software components. **ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS** * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or related discipline preferred. **LOCATION** Taiwan with ability to travel internationally, circa 20% within Asia, Europe and North America *Benefits offered are described:* AMD benefits at a glance. *AMD does not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment delivering production web or AI applications end to end. * Proven experience delivering solutions in complex, cross-functional environments and collaborating with data science, robotics, operations, and infrastructure teams. * Proficiency in one or more programming languages, such as Go, Python, Rust, or JavaScript. * Proficiency with SQL and experience working with relational or non-relational observability, and safe AI deployment practices. * Experience in semiconductor manufacturing, smart manufacturing, industrial automation, robotics, or another high-reliability engineering environment. **What Success Looks Like** ML/AI use cases to progress efficiently from concept to reliable production deployment. * Delivered solutions create measurable improvements in manufacturing productivity, quality, decision-making, or engineering efficiency. * AI applications meet agreed standards for security, reliability, maintainability, performance, and responsible use. * Reusable engineering patterns and components reduce delivery time and improve consistency across future AI projects. **About Micron Technology, Inc.** We are an industry leader in innovative memory and storage solutions transforming how the world uses information to enrich life *for all* . With a relentless focus on our customers, technology leadership, and manufacturing and operational excellence, Micron delivers a rich portfolio of high-performance DRAM, NAND, and NOR memory and storage products through our Micron® and Crucial® brands. Every day, the innovations that our people create fuel the data economy, enabling advances in artificial intelligence and 5G applications that unleash opportunities — from the data center to the intelligent edge and across the client and mobile user experience. To learn more, please visit micron.com/careers All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. To request assistance with the application process and/or for reasonable accommodations, please contact at hrsupport\_taiwan@micron.com. Micron Prohibits the use of child labor and complies with all applicable laws, rules, regulations, and other international and industry labor standards. new_jobs.title: AI Company - AI Product Engineer
new_jobs.jd: 我們是一家專注於 AI 與雲端應用 的新創公司，致力於開發具影響力的產品，讓使用者在日常生活中實際體驗科技所帶來的價值。 我們相信，好的產品不僅要功能完善，更應能夠解決真實問題、提升效率，並創造新的可能。 在 Koafaith，我們的團隊具備多元技術背景，從使用者體驗到核心系統皆有專長；同時由一群對科技充滿熱情的夥伴組成。 我們專注於打造同時兼顧 體驗、穩定性與可擴展性 的應用，每一位成員都善於運用開源與新技術，持續推動解決方案的進化與創新。 【必備條件】 * 具備全端開發能力,能 own 一個 feature 從 UI 到 API 到資料庫 * 網頁開發基本功紮實(響應式、accessibility、API 設計),不執著特定技術棧 — 能透過 AI 工具快速適應新框架 * 熟悉 Git / 版本控制流程(branch 管理、PR/MR 流程) * 對資料模型與儲存方案有判斷力 — 能根據需求選擇合適的方案(SQL / NoSQL / cache 等) * 熟悉雲端部署與容器化(Docker / Kubernetes),對服務架構拆分有判斷力(monolith vs 微服務) * 具備 background jobs 與 async / event-driven 處理經驗 * 善於活用 AI coding 工具(Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、GitHub Copilot 等)與 Prompt 提升開發效率 * 具備產品 trade-off 思維與跨職能協作能力 【加分項目】 * 對前端 UI craft 有要求 — 重視視覺一致性、互動細節與 accessibility,能用 AI 工具快速產出介面並迭代到 production 品質 * 對自動化部署與可觀測性有實作經驗(CI/CD、monitoring),重視流程自動化與系統健康可見度 * 熟悉系統與 API 安全(OAuth2、JWT、OWASP),並對 AI 應用安全有概念(prompt injection、agent safety、敏感資料外洩等) * 具備高流量或可擴展系統設計經驗(Scalability / Reliability / Observability) * 熟悉事件驅動架構或即時通訊開發(message queue、pub/sub、WebSocket 等) * 曾參與大型專案、開源貢獻或有個人 Side Project * 做過 LLM 整合的產品 feature(chatbot、summarization、agent 等) * 熟悉 prompt engineering、RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) 架構與向量資料庫(Qdrant / Pinecone / Weaviate 等) * 對 agentic 應用設計有概念(tool use、memory、evals) 我們期待加入的夥伴具備： * 熱愛學習、勇於挑戰，願意與團隊一同快速成長 * 擅長運用 AI 工具與 Prompt 提升生產力 * 對品質、效能與設計有高度追求 * 享受解決問題的快感

new_jobs.title: 行銷企劃專員
new_jobs.company: 英富霖諮詢股份有限公司
new_jobs.jd: 我們正在尋找一位具備 B2B 行銷經驗的資深行銷企劃專員，負責公司品牌/產品推廣與數位行銷策略之規劃與執行，透過整合線上與線下推廣、媒體關係經營及數據分析，提升品牌在國際市場的能見度與影響力。如果你熟悉 B2B 行銷，並渴望在國際舞台發揮專業，這將是你大展身手的絕佳機會。 ▉ 工作內容 1. 國內外線上、線下活動規劃與執行 2. 建立及維繫與媒體、協會及產業伙伴的關係，每月定期撰寫新聞稿及產業文章，提升品牌影響力與公信力。 3. 了解市場趨勢與客戶需求，規劃並經營與執行LinkedIn、Meta、WeChat 等社群經營提升關注數、閱讀與分享數。 4. 負責公司網站規劃/改版與用戶體驗優化、內容經營及前後台維護。 5. 收集、分析行銷成效數據，根據分析品牌活動的成果，調整行銷策略。 6. 負責外部合作的規劃與洽談，提升行銷活動效率。 ▉ 我們希望你具備 1. B2B 行銷經驗至少 3 年以上，並有獨立規劃與策略制定能力。 2. 能使用 GA 工具進行 SEO 與網站流量分析。 3. 邏輯清晰，能在分析行銷數據表現後確實轉化為策略與行動方案。 4. 喜歡挑戰、具備積極創新的精神，能在快速變化的產業中展現戰略思維。 5. 具備良好的溝通能力，能夠有效地與內外部利益相關者合作，實現品牌目標。 6. 良好的英文聽說讀寫能力。
